subject: number of digits removed in version 1.14?

messages.author: a8c6c8c6e51c077d
messages.subject: number of digits removed in version 1.14?
parts:
Hello, 

I used to be able to specify the number of digits to show on my tree but in the updated version this no longer seems to be an option. 
Is there still a simple way to do this?

For example, the following used to round my posterior values to 2 digits

ggtree(mytree, aes(color=branch.length), ndigits=2) + geom_text(aes(x=branch, label=posterior), size=2)

But in the current version the error "Warning: Ignoring unknown parameters: ndigits" occurs.

Any guidance would be appreciated. Thank you.

messages.author: cec41188340e8212
messages.subject: Re: number of digits removed in version 1.14?
parts:
Yes the parameter was removed as we can directly round the variable.

ggtree(mytree, aes(color=branch.length), ndigits=2) + geom_text(aes(x=branch, label=round(as.numeric(posterior), 2), size=2)
